description: Siła naciągu linki sterowniczej roweru, przy zmianie biegów is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Efneo Sp. z o.o.. Dane stanowią wynik badania wykonanego na rowerze testowym, w trakcie którego zapisywane były cztery wartości: siła nacisku na pedał, siła naciągu linki sterowniczej, obecność znacznika obrotu koła i obrotu korby rowerowej. Badanie prezentuje zmienność siły naciągu linki w zależności od biegu i nacisku na pedały. Coverage: Efneo Sp. z o.o.. The portal shows the English title as "Shifting cable wire tension by the gear change operation" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Efneo Sp. z o.o.. Its keywords include rower, rama rowerowa, rowery, rower miejski. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
